messages:
Ava (Marketing): uploaded draft for the global launch blog + webinar plan: https://docs.google/draft. Key asks: benchmark narrative clarity (cache-hot vs cold), webinar times for APAC/EMEA/NA, and inbound routing by region/timezone. Need sign-offs by EOD.

Noor (Growth APAC): We should schedule two webinar times: EMEA/NA live at 09:00 PT and APAC-friendly at 01:00 UTC+8 (local midday). Also suggest localized landing copy for JP/SG markets.

Priya (Product): Updated benchmark section to call out 'cache-hot vs cold' explicitly and included a mini table with test config note. Can we avoid % absolutes in the hero? Kept 'up to' language.

Elliot (Design): I'll export localized hero images with translated alt text placeholders. Pinged TranslateBot for JP/SG strings.

Ben (Sales Ops APAC): For routing: plan to tag leads by region and event_time. Proposed tags: `region=apac|emea|na`, `webinar_slot=apac|na`. Map `region=apac & lead_tier=enterprise` -> APAC-AE queue. I'll push mapping once tag strings are final.

LegalBot: auto-scan: "customer quote" placeholder flagged. Obtain consent before using company name. Also GDPR note: if webinar recording is downloadable, add checkbox consent on registration form.

Noor (Growth APAC): noted — we'll add consent checkbox and a localized privacy blurb. Also propose sending registrants a localized calendar invite (.ics) with timezone detection.

TranslateBot: JP copy draft uploaded: "製品ローンチ：高速で信頼性の高い推論を提供します". Please review for tone.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks — adding privacy checkbox and calendar ICS. I'll surface localized headline options in the doc. Priya, can you supply a one-line engineering quote for hero (short)?

Priya (Product): Quote: "Predictable tail latency and cache-aware batching make inference practical at scale." Shortened for hero variants.

Elliot (Design): assets uploaded: hero_global.jpg, hero_apac.jpg, thumb_apac.jpg. Left alt text and JP copy placement in doc.

Ben (Sales Ops APAC): Confirming tag strings: `region=apac|emea|na`, `lead_tier=enterprise|midmarket|smb`, `source=blog`. I'll deploy routing to staging after final confirm.

Ava (Marketing): Locking copy at 18:00 PT. Final checklist: legal consent language added, quote in hero, translations in place, UTMs + region tags documented. LaunchBot, reserve publish + webinar slots.

LaunchBot: Publish slot reserved: 2026-06-10 14:00 UTC. Webinar slots reserved: 2026-06-11 16:00 UTC (NA/EMEA), 2026-06-12 01:00 UTC+8 (APAC).

Ava (Marketing): Great — pushing to staging and will loop back with preflight preview for APAC marketing team tomorrow.
